description: We are Ayni SAR, a team of students passionate about programming and space exploration. For this year’s NASA Space Apps Challenge, we developed a web application that uses satellite SAR data to identify communities in Ayacucho at risk of landslides and mudslides. By analyzing soil moisture, terrain instability, and landslide risk, we provide community alerts and connect residents with support centers, helping them take preventive action and reduce the impact on lives.
